newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's STAR insurance to float 20 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's STAR insurance to float 20 pct stake.

text.p: Tunisia's insurance leading firm Societe Tunisienne d'Assurances et de Reassurances STAR plans to float a 20 percent stake in its capital as part of the government's privatisation programme, bourse sources said on Wednesday.
Officials at the company told Reuters 300,000 shares will be sold at a public offer this month at a price not yet disclosed.
The firm's capital is 15 million dinars.
It would be the first opening up of the capital of an insurance firm in Tunisia's privatisation programme.
STAR's net profits rose to 2.35 million dinars in 1996 from 1.5 million dinars in 1995, results showed on Wednesday.
State-controlled STAR is estimated to have a market share of more than one third of the total. ($=1.1062 dinar)
